name: Gong
description: Gong is a revenue intelligence platform that captures customer interactions and helps teams understand conversations, pipeline activity, and sales execution. Revenue teams use it to review calls, coach representatives, inspect deal signals, and coordinate go-to-market work.
agentUseSummary: Connect through Relay's Gong OAuth integration with only api:calls:read:basic, then let selected agents read up to 25 minimized call summaries in a date range capped at 31 days. Relay does not expose transcripts, participants, users, emails, media, custom data, AI insights, cursors, uploads, CRM writes, arbitrary API access, or mutations.

credentialRequirements.label: Gong OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use Relay's approved Gong integration client identifier.

credentialRequirements.label: Gong OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use Relay's approved Gong client secret; Relay encrypts it server-side.

credentialRequirements.label: Gong customer API base URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store the customer-specific HTTPS *.api.gong.io base URL returned by Gong's token endpoint.

capabilities.label: Read basic call summaries
capabilities.description: Use one pinned GET /v2/calls request for up to 25 minimized call summaries in a date range capped at 31 days.

allowed.label: Read Gong call summaries
allowed.description: Read up to 25 minimized basic call summaries within a validated date range of at most 31 days.

blocked.label: Change Gong
blocked.description: Call uploads, CRM data, user deletion, integration settings, and every mutation are outside Relay's V1 contract.

blocked.label: Read conversation content or people
blocked.description: Transcripts, participants, users, emails, media, meeting URLs, custom data, AI insights, and credit-consuming analysis are blocked.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary API requests
blocked.description: Cursor following, ranges over 31 days, custom routes, untrusted API origins, and raw API access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded basic call-summary reads run directly. Transcripts, participants, users, content, media, AI insights, paging, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one typed basic call-summary tool through Gong OAuth and a validated customer API origin.
Railway mounts one typed basic call-summary tool through Gong OAuth and a validated customer API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: No Relay Gong Collective integration, developer instance, OAuth credentials, approved publication, tech-admin test authorization, customer API base URL, representative fixtures, or workspace-permission matrix is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-setup owner requests a Gong developer instance, registers Relay's integration with the exact callback and only api:calls:read:basic, validates global tech-admin authorization and refresh-token rotation, captures the returned customer API origin as metadata, completes any Gong Collective review, then verifies bounded reads, permission and rate errors, minimization, agent assignment, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Gong documents developer instances, integration registration and publication, global tech-admin OAuth, authorization-code and refresh flows, exact scopes, bearer tokens, and a customer-specific api_base_url_for_customer returned with tokens.
Gong documents bearer OAuth, customer API access limits of three calls per second and 10,000 per day by default, 429 responses, cursor paging, and forward-compatible field minimization.

Gong documents GET /v2/calls, required fromDateTime and toDateTime inputs, api:calls:read:basic, cursor paging, and basic call metadata; Relay caps the range, result count, and fields and never sends a cursor.
